questions.question: Which of the following nutrients stores maximum energy per gram?

questions.question: What is the minimum amount which can be remitted through Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS)?
questions.solution:
**__Rs. 2,00,000__** is the minimum amount that can be remitted through **Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS).**

 
• The acronym **"RTGS"** stands for Real-Time Gross Settlement, which can be described as a mechanism where fund-transfers are settled continuously and in real-time, individually on a transaction basis (without netting).
 
• **"Real-Time"** means the delivery of instructions at the time of receipt; **"Gross Settlement**" means the settlement of instructions for the transfer of funds happens separately.
 
• The RTGS system is intended specifically for** large-value transactions.**
 
• The minimum amount to be remitted by RTGS is Rs. 2,00,000/- with no limit above or above.

• Any criminal proceedings cannot be started or continued in any court during its term of office against the President, or the Governor of a State.
 
• No court may grant arrest warrants for either President or Governor.
 
• Civil proceedings against a Governor or President over actions that he has done in his personal capacity can only be carried out with the prior notice of 2 months.

questions.question: The weight of an object on the moon is equal to ______ of its weight on the earth.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **The weight of an object **on the moon is equal to **1/6__th** **of its weight on the Earth.**
 
• Weight = (mass) × (acceleration due to gravity of planet)
 
• **At the surface of the earth**
 
• Weight = mg
 
• **At the surface of Moon**
 
• Weight = mg / 6
 
• ∵ Acceleration due to Moon’s gravity = (Acceleration due to Earth’s gravity)/6
 
• ∴ Weight on moon = 1/6 × Weight on earth

questions.question: The entire content of a living cell is known as ______ which includes the cytoplasm and the nucleus.
questions.solution:
The entire content of a** living cell **is known as **__protoplasm__** which includes** the cytoplasm and the nucleus.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Protoplasm** is the living part of a cell enclosed by a plasma membrane.
 
• It is composed of a** mixture of small molecules like ions, amino acids, monosaccharides and water, and macromolecules like nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, and polysaccharides.**
 
• Protoplasm was said to occur in two forms: a state of liquid sol or a state of gel-like jelly.
 
• In most eukaryotic organisms, the** mitochondrion** is a double-membrane-bound organelle.
 
• A** lysosome** is an organelle of** the membrane-bound** cell which contains digestive enzymes.
